properties.site-address: Car Park And Others, High Street/Jackson Lane, Wellingborough, NN8 4JJ
properties.notes: Allocated as Site C in the 2009 Wellingborough Town Centre Area Action Plan Allocated as policy site TC9 in the Plan for the Borough of Wellingborough which is aiming to be adopted by the council in February 2019.. WP/14/00175/FUL- Demolition of existing building at 48 West St and redevelopment of part of car park on High Street, Wellingborough for 114 dwellings consisting of 85 houses, 29 apartments, roads, car parking, landscaping and boundary treatments.. Development here would support Town centre regeneration. The site is a long term site allocation in both the Adopted TCAAP and in the emerging Plan for the Borough of Wellingborough as Policy site TC9.
